_comment: Per-PR mutation testing for apps/web (vitest); the mutation workflow passes the PR's changed files via --mutate. Manual 'workflow_dispatch' runs use this full scope: lib/** (pure business logic, fast unit tests). Widen once the baseline is stable. Incremental results live in reports/stryker-incremental.json, cached per-PR by the mutation workflow so synchronize re-runs only re-test changed mutants.
